name: Patchwork

setup.text: Put the central time board in the middle of the table.
Place the regular patches in a circle or oval around the time board.
Put the neutral token between the smallest patch, the 1x2, and the next patch clockwise.
Put the special patches on their marked spaces of the time board.
Keep the remaining buttons in a supply nearby.
Take a quilt board, a time token and 5 buttons. Put your time token on the start space.
The player who last used a needle goes first.

turn.summary: The player whose time token is furthest back takes the turn, so you can go several times in a row. Choose one action each turn.
steps: If both tokens are on one space, the player whose token is on top moves first.
Action A, advance: move your time token to the space directly in front of your opponent's token and take 1 button per space moved.
Action B, take and place a patch, in 5 steps.
1. Choose one of the three patches clockwise after the neutral token.
2. Move the neutral token next to the chosen patch.
3. Pay the buttons shown on the patch to the supply.
4. Put the patch on your quilt board without overlap. You may turn it.
5. Move your time token forward by the number on the patch. If you land on your opponent's space, place your token on top.

round_end: Whenever you move onto or past a marked time-board space, resolve it: take the special patch and place it at once, or take button income.
end: The game ends when both time tokens have reached the last space of the time board. A token that would go past it stops there.

scoring.text: Count your remaining buttons and add 7 if you have the special tile.
Subtract 2 for each empty space on your quilt board.

tiebreak: The player who reached the final space of the time board first.

missed.text: Turns are not alternate; you move again if your token is still behind.
You choose only from the next three patches clockwise from the neutral token.
Button income pays the sum of button symbols on your patches each time you pass an income space.
Special patches are the only way to fill single spaces and are placed immediately.
The first player to fill a 7x7 square on their quilt gets the 7-point special tile.
When advancing, you only gain buttons for spaces actually moved, even if the track ends.

unverified: Button symbol values on patches and the exact marked track spaces are printed as images, not in the text.
